sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2145596_ai_ena_0_investigation</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>US12 - Generate Investigation Insights</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[
(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    var investigationId = current.getUniqueValue();

    var sourceData = {
        findings: current.getValue('findings') || '',
        contact_tracing_information:
            current.getValue('contact_tracing_information') || '',
        exposure_history:
            current.getValue('exposure_history') || '',
        disease_case:
            current.getDisplayValue('disease_case') || '',
        investigation_status:
            current.getDisplayValue('investigation_status') || ''
    };

    // Prevent unnecessary repeated AI analysis
    var snapshot = JSON.stringify(sourceData);
    var existingSnapshot =
        current.getValue('ai_source_snapshot') || '';

    if (snapshot === existingSnapshot) {
    gs.info(
        '[US12] AI analysis skipped for ' +
        investigationId +
        ' because source information is unchanged.'
    );
    return;
	}

    try {

        // Mark the investigation as Processing
        var investigation = new GlideRecord(
            'x_2145596_ai_ena_0_investigation'
        );

        if (!investigation.get(investigationId)) {
            return;
        }

        investigation.setWorkflow(false);
        investigation.setValue('ai_insight_status', 'processing');
        investigation.update();

        // Initialize the US12 REST Message
        var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2(
            'US12 Investigation Insights API',
            'Generate Investigation Insights'
        );

        // Pass the investigation data to FastAPI
        request.setStringParameter(
            'investigation_id', investigationId
        );

        request.setStringParameter(
            'findings', sourceData.findings
        );

        request.setStringParameter(
            'contact_tracing_information',
            sourceData.contact_tracing_information
        );

        request.setStringParameter(
            'exposure_history', sourceData.exposure_history
        );

        request.setStringParameter(
            'disease_case', sourceData.disease_case
        );

        request.setStringParameter(
            'investigation_status', sourceData.investigation_status
        );

        // Execute the API request
        var response = request.execute();
        var responseBody = response.getBody();
        var statusCode = response.getStatusCode();

        if (statusCode < 200 || statusCode >= 300) {
            throw new Error(
                'API request failed. HTTP Status: ' +
                statusCode + '. Response: ' + responseBody
            );
        }

        var result = JSON.parse(responseBody);

        if (!result.success || !result.insights) {
            throw new Error('Invalid AI response received.');
        }

        var insights = result.insights;

        // Validate all four AI outputs
        var requiredFields = [
            'investigation_summary',
            'key_observations',
            'identified_patterns',
            'recommended_actions'
        ];

        for (var i = 0; i < requiredFields.length; i++) {
            var value = insights[requiredFields[i]];

            if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) {
                throw new Error(
                    'Missing AI output: ' + requiredFields[i]
                );
            }
        }

        // Retrieve the latest Investigation record
        var updateRecord = new GlideRecord(
            'x_2145596_ai_ena_0_investigation'
        );

        if (!updateRecord.get(investigationId)) {
            throw new Error('Investigation record not found.');
        }

        updateRecord.setWorkflow(false);

        // Store AI-generated insights
        updateRecord.setValue(
            'ai_insight_summary',
            insights.investigation_summary.substring(0, 2000)
        );

        updateRecord.setValue(
            'ai_key_observations',
            insights.key_observations.substring(0, 2000)
        );

        updateRecord.setValue(
            'ai_identified_patterns',
            insights.identified_patterns.substring(0, 2000)
        );

        updateRecord.setValue(
            'ai_recommended_actions',
            insights.recommended_actions.substring(0, 2000)
        );

        updateRecord.setValue(
            'ai_insight_status', 'completed'
        );

        // Save snapshot only after successful analysis
        updateRecord.setValue(
            'ai_source_snapshot', snapshot
        );

        updateRecord.update();

        gs.info(
            '[US12] AI insights generated successfully for ' +
            investigationId
        );

    } catch (error) {

        // Mark the analysis as Failed
        var failedRecord = new GlideRecord(
            'x_2145596_ai_ena_0_investigation'
        );

        if (failedRecord.get(investigationId)) {
            failedRecord.setWorkflow(false);
            failedRecord.setValue(
                'ai_insight_status', 'failed'
            );
            failedRecord.update();
        }

        gs.error(
            '[US12] AI analysis failed for ' +
            investigationId + ': ' + error.message
        );
    }

})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-19 16:56:32</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>7266f91347689b50a407ad54116d4369</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>US12 - Generate Investigation Insights</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="AI Enabled Public Health Disease Surveillance and Outbreak Response Platform" source="x_2145596_ai_ena_0">55323711474bcf10a407ad54116d43c4</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AI Enabled Public Health Disease Surveillance and Outbreak Response Platform">55323711474bcf10a407ad54116d43c4</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_7266f91347689b50a407ad54116d4369</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-19 17:28:12</sys_updated_on><template/><when>async_always</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=7266f91347689b50a407ad54116d4369"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2145596_ai_ena_0_disease_case</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>US10 - Predict Outbreak Risk</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /* null when async */) {

    try {

        // =========================================================
        // 1. Store the current Disease Case sys_id
        // =========================================================
        var caseSysId = current.getUniqueValue();

        // =========================================================
        // 2. Build the current Disease Case data
        // =========================================================
        var currentCase = {
            disease_name: current.getDisplayValue('disease_name'),
            disease_status: current.getDisplayValue('disease_status'),
            case_status: current.getDisplayValue('case_status'),
            severity: current.getDisplayValue('severity'),

            date_reported: current.getValue('date_reported') ?
                current.getValue('date_reported').substring(0, 10) : null,

            patient_gender: current.getDisplayValue('patient_gender'),

            patient_age: current.getValue('patient_age') ?
                parseInt(current.getValue('patient_age'), 10) : null,

            location: current.getDisplayValue('location')
        };


        // =========================================================
        // 3. Find historical Disease Cases
        //    Same disease + same location + previous 7 days
        // =========================================================
        var historicalCases = [];

        var gr = new GlideRecord(
            'x_2145596_ai_ena_0_disease_case'
        );

        // Same disease
        gr.addQuery(
            'disease_name',
            current.getValue('disease_name')
        );

        // Same location
        gr.addQuery(
            'location',
            current.getValue('location')
        );

        // Exclude current record
        gr.addQuery(
            'sys_id',
            '!=',
            caseSysId
        );

        // Previous 7 days
        gr.addQuery(
            'date_reported',
            '>=',
            'javascript:gs.daysAgoStart(7)'
        );

        // Latest records first
        gr.orderByDesc('date_reported');

        // Maximum historical records
        gr.setLimit(50);

        gr.query();


        // =========================================================
        // 4. Build historical case list
        // =========================================================
        while (gr.next()) {

            historicalCases.push({

                disease_name:
                    gr.getDisplayValue('disease_name'),

                disease_status:
                    gr.getDisplayValue('disease_status'),

                case_status:
                    gr.getDisplayValue('case_status'),

                severity:
                    gr.getDisplayValue('severity'),

                date_reported:
                    gr.getValue('date_reported') ?
                    gr.getValue('date_reported').substring(0, 10) :
                    null,

                patient_gender:
                    gr.getDisplayValue('patient_gender'),

                patient_age:
                    gr.getValue('patient_age') ?
                    parseInt(gr.getValue('patient_age'), 10) :
                    null,

                location:
                    gr.getDisplayValue('location')
            });
        }


        // =========================================================
        // 5. Create ML request payload
        // =========================================================
        var payload = {

            case: currentCase,

            historical_cases: historicalCases

        };


        // =========================================================
        // 6. Call FastAPI ML service
        // =========================================================
        var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2(
            'US10 Outbreak Risk Prediction API',
            'Predict Outbreak Risk'
        );

        request.setRequestHeader(
            'Content-Type',
            'application/json'
        );

        request.setRequestHeader(
            'Accept',
            'application/json'
        );

        request.setRequestBody(
            JSON.stringify(payload)
        );


        // Execute REST request
        var response = request.execute();

        var httpStatus = response.getStatusCode();

        var responseBody = response.getBody();


        // =========================================================
        // 7. Log API response
        // =========================================================
        gs.info(
            'US10 ML API HTTP Status: ' +
            httpStatus
        );

        gs.info(
            'US10 ML API Response: ' +
            responseBody
        );


        // =========================================================
        // 8. Process successful ML response
        // =========================================================
        if (httpStatus == 200) {

            var result = JSON.parse(responseBody);

            if (result.risk_level) {

                // =================================================
                // 9. Retrieve the saved Disease Case
                // =================================================
                var caseRecord = new GlideRecord(
                    'x_2145596_ai_ena_0_disease_case'
                );

                if (caseRecord.get(caseSysId)) {

                    // =============================================
                    // 10. Update Outbreak Risk Level
                    // =============================================
                    caseRecord.setValue(
                        'outbreak_risk_level',
                        result.risk_level.toLowerCase()
                    );


                    // =============================================
                    // 11. Update ML Confidence
                    // =============================================
                    if (
                        result.confidence !== undefined &&
                        result.confidence !== null
                    ) {

                        caseRecord.setValue(
                            'outbreak_risk_confidence',
                            (
                                parseFloat(result.confidence) * 100
                            ).toFixed(2)
                        );
                    }


                    // =============================================
                    // 12. Save prediction
                    // =============================================
                    caseRecord.update();


                    // =============================================
                    // 13. Log successful prediction
                    // =============================================
                    gs.info(
                        'US10 Outbreak Risk Prediction: ' +
                        result.risk_level +
                        ' | Confidence: ' +
                        result.confidence
                    );

                } else {

                    gs.error(
                        'US10: Could not find Disease Case ' +
                        caseSysId
                    );
                }

            } else {

                gs.error(
                    'US10 ML API response did not contain risk_level.'
                );
            }

        } else {

            // =====================================================
            // API returned an error
            // =====================================================
            gs.error(
                'US10 ML API failed. HTTP Status: ' +
                httpStatus +
                ' Response: ' +
                responseBody
            );
        }


    } catch (ex) {

        // =========================================================
        // 14. Handle unexpected errors
        // =========================================================
        gs.error(
            'US10 Outbreak Risk Prediction Error: ' +
            ex.message
        );
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-05 17:22:12</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>9c5cc2b8477f0350a407ad54116d439c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>US10 - Predict Outbreak Risk</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="AI Enabled Public Health Disease Surveillance and Outbreak Response Platform" source="x_2145596_ai_ena_0">55323711474bcf10a407ad54116d43c4</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AI Enabled Public Health Disease Surveillance and Outbreak Response Platform">55323711474bcf10a407ad54116d43c4</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_9c5cc2b8477f0350a407ad54116d439c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-05 17:40:30</sys_updated_on><template/><when>async_always</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=9c5cc2b8477f0350a407ad54116d439c"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_entry"><sys_transform_entry action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><choice_action>create</choice_action><coalesce>false</coalesce><coalesce_case_sensitive>false</coalesce_case_sensitive><coalesce_empty_fields>false</coalesce_empty_fields><date_format>yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss</date_format><map display_value="US10 Disease Case Sample Transform V2">ed4485a847b38f10a407ad54116d43c0</map><reference_value_field/><source_field>u_disease_name</source_field><source_script><![CDATA[answer = (function transformEntry(source) {

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2145596_ai_ena_0_disease_case</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>US-11_AutomaticallyCalculateCasePriority</name><order>200</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[
(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    // Run on insert, or when severity/risk changes
    if (current.operation() !== 'insert' &&
        !current.severity.changes() &&
        !current.outbreak_risk_level.changes()) {
        return;
    }

    var severity = (current.getValue('severity') || '').toLowerCase();
    var risk = (current.getValue('outbreak_risk_level') || '').toLowerCase();

    var priority = 'normal';

    // Priority calculation
    if (severity === 'critical') {

        priority = 'critical';

    } else if (severity === 'high') {

        priority = (risk === 'high') ? 'critical' : 'high';

    } else if (severity === 'medium') {

        priority = (risk === 'high') ? 'high' : 'medium';

    } else if (severity === 'low') {

        priority = (risk === 'high') ? 'medium' : 'normal';

    }

    current.setValue('case_priority', priority);

})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-09 07:24:06</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>07af0c8847a01310a407ad54116d4321</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>US-11_AutomaticallyCalculateCasePriority</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="AI Enabled Public Health Disease Surveillance and Outbreak Response Platform" source="x_2145596_ai_ena_0">55323711474bcf10a407ad54116d43c4</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AI Enabled Public Health Disease Surveillance and Outbreak Response Platform">55323711474bcf10a407ad54116d43c4</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_07af0c8847a01310a407ad54116d4321</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-09 09:12:44</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=07af0c8847a01310a407ad54116d4321"/></record_update>
